datasheet_identity.title: MMBD41418A THRU MMBD4148SE FAST SWITCHING DIODES

extraction_notes: The reverse-leakage table also specifies a maximum of 25 nA at VR = 25 V; reverse_current records the rated VR = 75 V row.
No typical electrical-table values are published for this family entry; the plotted Ta = 25 degC characteristics were digitized separately.
The forward, reverse, and capacitance plots were digitized from the Ta = 25 degC traces without interpolation between reported table rows.

The p. 1 Maximum Ratings row lists Reverse Breakdown voltage @ IR = 100 uA, symbol V_BR(R), as 75 V. The 100 uA is only the row's test current, not an independently guaranteed breakdown-current limit. Because this maximum-ratings entry has no explicit guaranteed minimum or typical value and is below the separate 100 V VRRM rating, breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are omitted rather than treating 75 V as a measured maximum or guaranteed breakdown pair.
